svg.text: 3. Queries D2 (National IDs) for exact matches
4. Queries D3 (Criminal Records) for fuzzy matches
5. Creates request entry in D5 + logs to D8
4. Updates D4 (Convictions), triggers repeat offender calc
6. Records all actions in D8 (Audit Logs)
2. AI compares against all D3 records
4. If similarity score > 80% → flags as duplicate in D6
1. User requests report for record → Process 5
2. Creates JSONB snapshot from D3, generates SHA-256 hash
3. Stores report in D7 with unique ID (RPT-YYYYMMDD-XXXX)
4. All user changes logged to D8
✓ Per-table policies: SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE
✓ Cannot be bypassed in application code
✓ Immutable audit logs (D8): no updates/deletes allowed
✓ All actions logged: CREATE, READ, UPDATE, DELETE, LOGIN
✓ Metadata captured: user, IP, user agent, timestamp
✓ Snapshots stored: old & new values (for updates)
Process 2 (Verify): ↔ D2, D3, D5 | Reads: D1
Data Tables: 9 tables | Enums: 8 types | Indexes: 20+ optimized
Processes: 7 core flows | API Endpoints: 15+ Next.js routes
RLS Policies: 35+ policies | Security: Row-level, role-based, audit-logged
Users: 4 roles (Admin, Police, Court, Prison) | Auth: Supabase Auth + Sessions
